# Using Forge Os

## Core principle

Route one project from confirmed intent to the next evidence-backed state without loading unrelated skills. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a simple factual question with no product workflow
- an existing non-ForgeOS workflow the user did not ask to migrate

Load only the sections selected by the RoutePlan.
